functional.note: All three instances voted functional PASS on the axis they were asked to judge (do the acceptance criteria and the frozen contract hold). Two of the three independently added a gate-level BLOCK recommendation on grounds outside the AC set, observing that the frozen contract for group A is three GET /health checks and therefore too narrow to carry the merge decision on its own.

gate_verdict_basis: Both voted axes returned a unanimous PASS majority, so no fail-safe was triggered. The gate is BLOCK on the single-instance code-review axis (CR-301), which sits outside the vote and is sufficient alone, and is corroborated by evaluator instances 2 and 3 (F-2, MAJOR) and by security instances 2 and 3 (SEC2-W1, SEC3-001) as the same underlying defect at a lower severity.

B-1.note: Route label now derives from the matched route template, so the raw path is no longer a label channel. slo-check.js reports error_rate_pct 0 where round 2 measured a forged 99.90%. Residual: _escape_label still omits CR and ~29 other C0 characters, unreachable under the shipped httptools parser.

B-2.note: Route dimension bounded and verified by measurement up to 60,000 distinct paths. The method dimension is still unbounded in application code; see CR-301. Bounded to llhttp's method table under the shipped uvicorn[standard]/httptools parser, unbounded under the pure-Python h11 fallback.

B-3.note: Verified by live request: 405 keeps Allow, 401 keeps WWW-Authenticate, 409/429 keep custom headers; 404/422/500 envelopes intact. A real regression test exists at backend/tests/unit/test_error_envelope.py:189.

B-4.downgrade_basis: Untouched by all six remediation commits and reproduced at full magnitude by four instances (format() 4,088-4,168 ms from the 8-byte input; 421,224-429,464 ms from the 9-byte input; quadratic at ~4x per doubling across three or more doublings). Round 2's refutation is now positively explained: it timed toFixed(), a linear sink measuring 0.6-3.2 ms, roughly 1,260-7,000x cheaper than the real one. Downgraded from BLOCK to WARN by four independent reachability analyses agreeing that format()'s only caller is MoneyText, whose only callers are tests: frontend/src holds two files with no entry point or fetch layer, and the backend cannot emit such a value because Money._quantize rejects beyond 28-digit precision. Escalates to BLOCK/high on the first commit that mounts MoneyText against non-backend input.

cross_instance_disputes_resolved.resolution: Settled. The regex is the cost, not toFixed(). Round 2's evaluator-3 refutation timed the wrong sink; security-3 was right. Reconfirmed independently by eval-1, eval-2, eval-3, sec-3 and code-review with consistent quadratic curves.

cross_instance_disputes_resolved.item: Money.multiply timing (round 2: 9,708 ms vs 109 ms, unresolved)
cross_instance_disputes_resolved.resolution: Settled: neither figure was right. decimal.Overflow escapes in 0.0 ms. There is no denial of service; it is a contract break (bare ArithmeticError instead of InvalidMoneyAmountError, so 500 rather than 422). money.py catches only InvalidOperation. Filed SEC3-011 / F-6.

Not a contradiction; parser-dependent. httptools/llhttp admits only its fixed method table (~35), giving a bounded constant; h11 admits arbitrary tchar tokens, giving unbounded growth (measured 20,000-22,003 distinct values, 25.3 MB retained, 330,064 exposition lines). The shipped config resolves to httptools via uvicorn[standard] and uv.lock, which is why severity splits between the axes.

Partially refuted. Installing the filter on root only kills both AC2 tests, so 'vacuous' overstates it. The real defects, both executed: the property holds only at the instant configure_logging() returns, and the docstring's non-vacuity claim is empirically false because a constructor-built probe logger never enters loggerDict. AC2 passes; recorded as WARN.

unscanned_tiers.js_dependency_cve: npm audit ran: 1 critical (vitest) + 1 high (vite) + 3 moderate, all devDependency-only and absent from any production image
unscanned_tiers.note: Inferential security review by three instances was the only real coverage for the injection, authz and PII classes this round. Run with explicit --files per round 2's GI-001; the skill-documented '--all --staged --boundary-only' scans zero files and self-reports a clean pass.

gate_integrity_findings.detail: security-scan.js with --all --staged --boundary-only yields files=[] when nothing is staged and reports a clean pass having scanned zero files. runDeps() probes only the repo root for package.json, so npm audit never runs against frontend/. Always pass explicit --files.

The gate-checks registry invokes regression-gate.js with only --replay, never --exclude-group, so discoverPriorContracts() grades the unbuilt groups B-M as prior baselines and emits 404 findings. Re-run with B-M excluded: regression-gate pass. Blocking verdict from the registry invocation is an artifact.
canvas-sync-check.js changedFiles() has no exclusion filter for harness state, so it blocks on .claude/state/red-phase-presnap.json. Product-scope re-run is synchronized (13 files, 0 missing).

The gate skill documents 'npm run sensor-waivers', but this project has no root package.json, so that command fails with ENOENT. The actual validator is .claude/scripts/validate-sensor-waivers.js, which passes (5 waivers, none expired).

Concurrent 3-instance re-verification in a single shared working tree is not safe. Instances mutation-test production files simultaneously; three of the seven agents reported observing a sibling's live '# MUTANT' edit to backend/src/api/middleware.py or platform/routes.py, and the canonical security instance had to git-checkout two live mutants before it could re-derive its verdicts. Transient collateral: npm test reported 20 tests instead of 18 while a sibling probe file sat in frontend/tests/unit/, repo-wide ruff failed on a sibling scratch directory, and a shared slo-verdict.json was overwritten mid-run. Fix: give each instance its own git worktree, not merely its own port. All instances bracketed their measurements with git diff checks and the final tree is verified clean, but no instance can fully vouch for another's in-tree measurements this round.

gate_integrity_findings.status: known, recorded in the waiver itself
gate_integrity_findings.detail: run-gate-checks.js has no waiver-application path (waivers apply at pre-commit only), so ownership-check will keep reporting as blocked even when a ratified waiver covers the exact file.

evidence-integrity (G39) passes with applicable:false because no sprint contract declares playwright checks. The pass is honest but vacuous for group A - it verifies no browser claim because none was made. Do not read it as evidence of browser-backed verification.
